Matia...?

en: Ab...el.... Abel... Abel!!

en: ......No. Abel is... close by... Nooo...

en: Matia! What's wrong! Matia!

en: That's about enough of the touching reunion, eh?
...Aragi

en: Been a while, Mister Tribunal General.
You...

en: Ah-ah, don't move. Those monsters you love so much have you surrounded.
Grrrrrrrrrrr

jp: サンバルテルミの崩壊は
貴様の仕業だったのか
en: ...I see. So San Bartelmi's collapse was your doing.

en: Hyahaha! 'Doing' is a harsh way to put it.

jp: 俺は、あんたらの研究を
手伝ってやったんだぜ？
en: I was helping you lot with your research, wasn't I?

en: Silence... I've no ear for your nonsense.

jp: オマエらの悲願だった
en: Hey, hey, you sure? Your long-cherished dream, the Inverted Tree Plan--

jp: 俺が解明してやったってのに
en: --I'm the one who cracked it for you.
What...?

jp: 興味があるって顔だな、ま、
俺のご高説をじっくり聞きなって
en: Kukuku... That face says you're curious. Well, sit back for my esteemed lecture.

jp: 世界中に点在する巨大な樹、
あらゆる生命に力を与える
en: Great trees the world over, giving power to all life--the World Tree, mother of life.

jp: はるか数百年前、何を間違ったか
天使と悪魔が手を組んで、
これを利用する計画をおっ立てた
en: Centuries ago, by some mistake, angels and demons teamed up on a plan to use it.

jp: 何に利用しようとしたか、
ま、今じゃそれも分からねぇが、
en: What they meant to use the World Tree's power for, well, nobody knows anymore, but...

jp: とにかくおまえ達教団は、
その力を手に入れるために、
en: Anyway, to get hold of that power, you in the Church revived the ancient texts.

jp: ・・いにしえの業＜倒立樹計画＞
en: ...The ancient art, the Inverted Tree Plan.
Hyahaha, that's right.

jp: 計画の鍵はインセストが握る
en: The key to the plan lies with the Incests. That much you lot already know.

jp: インセストを手に入れても
en: But even once you got your hands on Incests,

jp: 世界樹を制御する方法が
en: you never cracked the final wall: how to control the World Tree.

jp: せいぜい出来たことといえば、
いじりまわしたあげくに
en: The most you managed was to tinker with them till they died, or

jp: このオンボロ世界樹の寿命を
つなぎ止める＜制御装置＞の
役割を与えたぐらいだ
en: to use them as a control device keeping this clapped-out World Tree alive.

jp: だがな・・・・それは
en: But see.... you had it backwards.
Backwards?

jp: 俺も最初分からなくってなぁ、
世界樹を直接ブっ壊して
やったりもしたんだが、
en: I didn't get it at first either. I even tried smashing the World Tree directly, but

jp: こいつが反応を返すのは、
もっと別のことだったんだよ
en: what this thing responds to turned out to be something else entirely.
What are you getting at?

jp: 俺がココで何をやったか、
en: Don't get it? Think back on what I did here.

jp: 世界樹の力を引き出す鍵・・
en: The key to drawing out the World Tree's power... is Man.
Forgotten, have you? What's the race of Man said to be born from?
Silence... Those words are taboo!
In this church, I let loose a swarm of Pasca,

jp: そこらじゅうに居るやつらを
en: and had them kill everyone around, one after another.

jp: ・・・なんて・・ヒドイことを
en: ...What a... horrible thing to do.
Here's my conclusion... The World Tree responds to Man's pain and death!!

jp: ＜ヒト＞の死に感応した世界樹は
大量のエネルギーを溜め込み、
en: A World Tree that feels Man's deaths stores up massive amounts of energy,

jp: やがてその力は許容量を超え、
en: and before long that power exceeds its capacity and reaches critical mass!!
The Incest is the final 'detonator,' you might say.

jp: そんな力は破壊しか生まん！！
en: But such a power can only give birth to destruction!!

jp: ・・・それで充分じゃねぇか
en: ...And that's plenty, isn't it.

jp: アラギ・・・・・まさか、
私がそんなことはさせんっ！！
en: Aragi..... Don't tell me... you! I won't let you do it!!

jp: 集えファントム・ペイン
en: Gather, Phantom Pain.

jp: ここに幾千の＜ヒト＞族を

Wooooooooom

Matiaaaa!!

嬢ちゃんはもったいねぇ素材だ
en: well, the little lady's too fine a specimen to waste on this old tree.

jp: おあつらえむきの、力に満ちた
世界樹を見つけてやるぜ

例え束になってかかってきても

What?!
Cain, are you all right?
....Jo...hannes?
...Everyone, you're all safe!!

jp: 決着をつけるよアラギ

Luca...
Tch...
Prepare yourself, Aragi.

俺に敵うと思ってるのか？

Young man
